items.title: Splitting of the conormal sequence for a composite of immersions detects regularity of both factors over a locally Noetherian base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a composite of two immersions over a locally Noetherian base, regularity of both factors, regularity of the composite together with regularity of the first factor, and regularity of the composite together with split exactness of the conormal sequence are equivalent (statement lines 5144-5163). The counted proof is a compact local algebra argument: it reduces to local rings where all notions of regular immersion agree, cites two implications, and then proves the remaining one by choosing a minimal generating system of the larger ideal whose first part minimally generates the smaller ideal, using the assumed splitting, observing that this system is a regular sequence and splitting it according to the definition of a regular sequence to obtain the two shorter sequences (proof lines 5165-5197). It is H2: the argument is carried out in the counted span and its inputs are the standard criteria for regular sequences and conormal sequences.
